# Patient RX System v2.0.65

## Dashboard Analytics and Pagination Performance

- Promotes the tested staging dashboard analytics improvements to production.
- Adds production-ready over-time graph support for dashboard trend metrics.
- Moves RX Records list display to database-level pagination so only the visible page is loaded.
- Adds RX Records workflow-stage filtering.
- Moves Patient Report and RX Action Report screen display to database-level pagination.
- Keeps report CSV/Excel export as full filtered export, fetched only when the export button is used.
- Defaults Patient Management, RX Records, Patient Report, and RX Action Report to 10 rows per page.

## Database Impact

- Run the normal production migration/startup path so the `DailySnapshots` trend columns are present.
- No destructive data changes are included. Existing patients, RX records, workflow history, and reports data are preserved.
- Existing performance indexes cover the promoted paginated query paths.
- Future optional tuning: if production text searches become slow at much larger data volume, add stronger functional or trigram indexes for name/search fields.

## Validation

- JavaScript syntax checks passed for the modified controllers and browser scripts.
- RX Records inline page script validation passed.
- `npm run db:migrate` completed with the schema already up to date on the checked environment.
- Development API smoke checks passed for RX Records, RX workflow-stage filtering, Patient Report pagination, and RX Action Report pagination.
- A fresh production build and update zip are generated for version `2.0.65`.
